sidebar.noModels: No models configured. Please go to Settings to add one.
sidebar.deleteConfirmDesc: This will permanently remove {{count}} message(s) from this point onward.
sidebar.compactNothing: Nothing to compact yet — this chat is still under the {{tokens}} recent-token budget.

quickActionPrompt.summarizePage: Read this page and summarize it: what it is about, its main points, and the conclusion. Keep it concise and reply in my language.
quickActionPrompt.translatePage: Read this page and translate its main content into my language. Preserve the structure (headings, lists, tables) and do not add commentary.
quickActionPrompt.keyPointsPage: Read this page and extract its key points as a short bulleted list. One idea per bullet, no filler.
quickActionPrompt.extractDataPage: Read this page and extract the structured data it contains (tables, lists, product/contact/price fields) as a Markdown table. State it plainly if the page holds no structured data.
quickActionPrompt.explainPage: Read this page and explain what it is and what it is for, in plain language, as if to someone seeing it for the first time.
quickActionPrompt.translateSelection: Translate the text above into my language. Return only the translation.
quickActionPrompt.explainSelection: Explain the text above in plain language. If it contains jargon, code, or references, unpack those too.
quickActionPrompt.describeImage: Describe this image in detail: what it shows, any text it contains, and anything notable about it.
quickActionPrompt.extractTextImage: Extract all text visible in this image. Preserve the reading order and layout, and return only the text.

systemPrompt.title: Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Instructions sent ahead of every conversation. Use them to shape the assistant’s role, tone and how it handles browser tools.
systemPrompt.enabledDesc: When off, no system instructions are sent and the model relies solely on tool schemas.
systemPrompt.injectTimeDesc: Prepend the current local time to the system prompt so the model is aware of the time context.
systemPrompt.placeholder: Describe how the assistant should behave...

commands.title: Commands
commands.enableCommandsDesc: When off, typing / in the input does nothing and no command expands on send.
commands.name: Trigger
commands.nameHint: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Typed after /.
commands.phraseHint: Replaces the trigger when you send. Text typed after it is kept.

errors.nameWhitespace: Spaces are not allowed in a trigger.
errors.nameSlash: Do not include / — it is added automatically.
errors.phraseRequired: Enter the text this command expands to.

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: Reference browser tabs and files with @.
mentions.enableMentionsDesc: When off, typing @ in the input does nothing and no mention picker appears.
mentions.tabsDesc: Reference open tabs as page context attachments.
mentions.filesDesc: Reference stored files as file attachments.

ui.title: Personalization
ui.maxSplitPanelsDesc: Maximum number of chat panels displayed side by side when the sidebar is wide enough.
ui.sendKeyDesc: Send with plain Enter, or with Enter + any modifier key (Ctrl/⌘/Alt/Shift).
ui.pasteThresholdDesc: Turn a long paste into a text attachment instead of inserting it into the input box.
ui.maxStepsDesc: How many tool calls one reply may chain before it stops.
ui.autoCollapseReasoningDesc: Collapse a reasoning block once it finishes streaming, instead of leaving it open.
ui.turnNotificationDesc: Show a system notification when a reply finishes, so a long task can run in the background.
ui.compactionEnabledDesc: Summarize older history into a checkpoint as the context fills up, so long chats keep going.
ui.compactionReserveDesc: Headroom kept free for the next reply before compacting — a fixed token count or a share of the model window.

chatDebug.title: Debug
chatDebug.description: Inspect the current conversation with full AI SDK interaction details.
chatDebug.noConversation: No active conversation. Start a chat in the sidebar to see debug info here.
chatDebug.refreshHint: Data syncs automatically from the active sidebar conversation.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide tools to the AI assistant.
mcp.authReasonAuthorizationRequired: Sign in to use this server.
mcp.authReasonInsufficientScope: Your sign-in does not include the permissions this server now requires. Sign in again to grant them.
mcp.authReasonNoRegistration: This server needs a token but does not support automatic client registration. Add an Authorization header to this server instead.
mcp.authReasonIdentityMissing: Reload the extension to activate the identity permission, then sign in again.
mcp.authReasonBusy: Another sign-in is already open in this browser. Finish or close it first.
mcp.authReasonServerFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check this server's OAuth configuration or add an Authorization header instead.
mcp.authReasonTemporary: The authorization server is rate limiting this browser. Wait a moment, then try again.
mcp.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this server?
